evidence_quotes.O: First, let me say that I am not terribly techy. I can barely turn on the TV anymore.
evidence_quotes.C: Earthquakes in Hawaii that left everyone starnded without power or news taught me how unimportant these things are until ALL OF A SUDDEN they become important. Be prepared.
evidence_quotes.E: WOW, in just a few days I have grown to love this thing and can't imagine life without it!
evidence_quotes.A: It isn't perfect, however for the very low price I have to bump up the rating.
evidence_quotes.N: I continued to snap amazing pictures of the storm, not worried at all about the camera getting drenched.
